clips.text: Please introduce yourself briefly, and tell me about the AI work you are doing now.
What is RAG, and why did you use it for BTEC questions?
Is the similarity checker a RAG system? Why or why not?
What is Agentic AI, and which of your projects used it?
Have you used LangGraph in production? What did you use instead?
Why did you use Recall, not Accuracy, in the early-warning project?
How does Whisper fit in your kiosk project? Did you use an LLM there?
How do you stop School A from seeing School B documents in search?
